en.title: [BK21 Logistics Education & Research Group] 2026 6th Special Lecture by Overseas Visiting Scholar (Nov 17)
summary: The BK21 Logistics Education & Research Group (BK21 물류 교육연구단) is hosting the 6th Special Lecture by an Overseas Visiting Scholar for the 2026 academic year.
Topic: Learning Back and Forth: From Behaviors to Optimal Policy (Speaker: Prof. Chi-Guhn Lee, University of Toronto).
Date & Location: November 17, 2026 (Tue) at 10:30 AM, Inha University 2N464.
Anyone interested is welcome to attend.
en.easyExplanation: This is a special lecture by an overseas visiting scholar hosted by the BK21 Logistics Education & Research Group. Professor Chi-Guhn Lee from the University of Toronto will give the talk, and anyone interested is welcome to attend. It takes place at Inha University 2N464 on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 10:30 AM.
en.eventInfo: Special lecture by Prof. Chi-Guhn Lee (University of Toronto) at Inha University 2N464

author: 이성인
originalContent:
디지털 전환 시대 사회적 격차 해소 물류 교육연구단에서는 아래와 같이 해외 석학 초빙 특강을 진행합니다.
관심 있으신 분들의 많은 참여를 바랍니다.
1. 주제: Learning Back and Forth: From Behaviors to Optimal Policy
2. 일시 및 장소: 2026.11.17.(화) 10:30 / 인하대학교 2N464
3. 강연자: Prof. Chi-Guhn Lee(University of Toronto)
